propositions: The MCP unlink_tickets callable omits the optional relation parameter from its FastMCP signature, preventing callers from specifying which edge to remove when a ticket pair holds multiple relations.
The unlink_tickets implementation fails to forward the relation parameter to rebar.unlink, causing the most-recent edge to be removed as a fallback regardless of caller intent.
When relation is supplied to MCP unlink_tickets, the live schema does not advertise it as an accepted field due to the signature omission.
Supplying an explicit relation value should remove only that edge while preserving other relations between the same ticket pair, but the current implementation cannot achieve this.
The public CLI library and Python library already support relation-specific unlink with total parameter parity, but the MCP adapter diverges from this contract.
